content: Official NIPs provide current building blocks: NIP-23 addressable Markdown long-form; NIP-58 issuer-defined immutable non-transferable badge awards with user opt-in display; NIP-05 DNS identities; NIP-50 relay search; NIP-09 deletion requests and NIP-62 relay-targeted vanish requests; NIP-52 calendars/RSVP; NIP-57 Lightning zaps; NIP-34 repo announcements, patches, PRs, issues and statuses; NIP-51 lists including curation sets, relay feeds, directories and followed repos. Client support remains uneven and NIP-29 roles/membership are relay-policy dependent.
